items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; Han lexicographic tradition, modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern seal-script-style redraw of 忘, attributed by Commons to Hanziyuan image S07737. It represents the form discussed in the received Shuowen analysis.
items.alt: Digital vector rendering of 忘 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description identifies the character, names its historical script style, gives a source image reference and states public-domain reuse for the SVG representation. It is useful as a later received-form illustration but does not establish the compound’s earliest form.
items.rights: Public domain for the SVG representation according to the exact Commons description page; modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The drawing is a modern redraw of a historical script style, not an ancient artifact image. The direct image URL could not be opened in the research tool, so pixel inspection was not performed. It does not establish the earliest form or date of 忘.
